label: AI Service Quality
definition: MISSING

label: Acceptability
definition: Extent to which a human response is favourable when accepting or installing a product, system or service software tool designed to perform some frequently used function

label: Service Accessibility
definition: Extent to which products, systems, services, environments and facilities can be used by people from a population with the widest range of user needs, characteristics and capabilities to achieve identified goals in identified contexts of use

label: Accountability
definition: Capability of a product to enable actions of an entity to be traced uniquely to the entity

label: Adaptability
definition: Capability of a product to be effectively and efficiently adapted for or transferred to different hardware, software or other operational or usage environments

label: Analysability
definition: Capability of a product to be effectively and efficiently assessed regarding the impact of an intended change to one or more of its parts, to diagnose it for deficiencies or causes of failures, or to identify parts to be modified

label: Appropriateness
definition: Degree to which an IT service provides results that are appropriate for the user  needs

label: Appropriateness Recognizability
definition: Capability of a product to be recognized by users as appropriate for their needs

label: Authenticity
definition: Capability of a product to prove that the identity of a subject or resource is the one claimed

label: Availability
definition: Capability of a product to be operational and accessible when required for use

label: Beneficialness
definition: Extent of benefit resulting from the use of a product, system or service

label: Capacity
definition: Capability of a product to meet requirements for the maximum limits of a product parameter

label: Co-existence
definition: Capability of a product to perform its required functions efficiently while sharing a common environment and resources with other products, without detrimental impact on any other product

label: Compatibility
definition: Capability of a product to exchange information with other products, and/or to perform its required functions while sharing the same common environment and resources

label: Completeness
definition: Degree to which an AI service supports all the specified goals, objectives and data specified by the user

label: Compliance
definition: Extent to which a user or other stakeholder has confidence that a product, system, software, or service in use meets requirements, as required by rules or laws

label: Confidentiality
definition: Capability of a product to ensure that data are accessible only to those authorized to have access

label: Consistency
definition: Degree to which repeated or similar related IT services provided consistent quality

label: Continuity
definition: Degree to which the AI service is provided under all foreseeable circumstances, including mitigating the risks resulting from interruption to an acceptable level

label: Correctness
definition: Degree to which an IT service uses the correct process and produces the correct results with accurate data

label: Courtesy
definition: Degree to which the AI service is provided in a polite, respectful and friendly way

label: Customizability
definition: Degree to which the AI service can be customized at the request of users

label: EconomicRiskMitigation
definition: Extent to which a product or system mitigates the potential risk to financial status, efficient operation, commercial property, reputation, or other aspects in the intended contexts of use

label: Environmental Risk Mitigation
definition: Degree to which a product or system mitigates the potential risk to the environment in the intended contexts of use

label: Environmental Sustainability
definition: State in which the ecosystem and its functions are maintained for the present and future generations

label: Experience
definition: Extent to which users or stakeholders accumulate knowledge or skill acquired over time, especially that gained in a particular profession

label: Fail Safe
definition: Capability of a product to automatically place itself in a safe operating mode, or to revert to a safe condition in the event of a failure

label: Fault Tolerance
definition: Capability of a product to operate as intended despite the presence of hardware or software faults

label: Faultlessness
definition: Capability of a product to perform specified functions without fault under normal operation

label: Flexibility
definition: Capability of a product to be adapted to changes in its requirements, contexts of use, or system environment

label: Functional Adaptability
definition:
Degree to which an AI system can accurately acquire information from data, or the result of previous actions,
and use that information in future predictions

label: Functional Appropriateness
definition: Capability of a product to provide functions that facilitate the accomplishment of specified tasks and objectives.

label: Functional Completeness
definition: Capability of a product to provide a set of functions that covers all the specified tasks and intended users’ objectives.

label: Functional Correctness
definition: Degree to which a product or system provides the correct results with the needed degree of precision

label: Functional Suitability
definition: Capability of a product to provide functions that meet stated and implied needs of intended users when it is used under specified conditions.

label: Hazard Warning
definition: Capability of a product to provide warnings of unacceptable risks to operations or internal controls so that they can react in sufficient time to sustain safe operations

label: Health Risk Mitigation
definition: Extent to which a product or system  mitigates the potential risk to people’s health in the intended contexts of use

label: Human Life Risk Mitigation
definition: Extent to which a product  or system mitigates the potential risk to people’s lives in the intended contexts of use

label: Inclusivity
definition: Capability of a product to be utilised by people of various backgrounds

label: Initiative
definition: Degree to which the AI service recognizes users’ goals and service suggests changes to meet users’ needs

label: Installability
definition: Capability of a product to be effectively and efficiently installed successfully and/or uninstalled in a specified environment

label: Integrity
definition: Capability of a product to ensure that the state of its system and data are protected from unauthorized modification or deletion either by malicious action or computer error

label: Interaction Capability
definition: Capability of a product to be interacted with by specified users to exchange information between a user and a system via the user interface to complete the intended task

label: Interoperability
definition: Capability of a product to exchange information with other products and mutually use the information that has been exchanged

label: Intervenability
definition: Degree to which an operator can intervene in an AI system’s functioning in a timely manner to prevent harm or hazard

label: Learnability
definition: Capability of a product to have specified users learn to use specified product functions within a specified amount of time

label: Maintainability
definition: Capability of a product to be modified by the intended maintainers with effectiveness and efficiency

label: Modifiability
definition: Capability of a product to be effectively and efficiently modified without introducing defects or degrading existing product quality

label: Modularity
definition: Capability of a product to limit changes to one component from affecting other components

label: Non-repudiation
definition: Capability of a product to prove that actions or events have taken place, so that the events or actions cannot be repudiated later

label: Operability
definition: Capability of a product to have functions and attributes that make it easy to operate and control

label: Operational Constraint
definition: Capability of a product to constrain its operation to within safe parameters or states when encountering operational hazard

label: Performance Efficiency
definition: Capability of a product to perform its functions within specified time and throughput parameters and be efficient in the use of resources under specified conditions

label: Product Quality
definition: MISSING

label: Professionalism
definition: Degree to which the content of the AI service is based on appropriate education, skill, expertise and qualification

label: Quality In Use
definition: MISSING

label: Reactiveness
definition: Degree to which the AI service promptly responds to user  requests

label: Recoverability
definition: Capability of a product in the event of an interruption or a failure to recover the data directly affected and re-establish the desired state of the system

label: Reliability
definition: Capability of a product to perform specified functions under specified conditions for a specified period of time without interruptions and failures

label: Replaceability
definition: Capability of a product to replace another specified product for the same purpose in the same environment

label: Resistance
definition: Capability of a product to sustain operations while under attack from a malicious actor

label: Resource Utilization
definition: Capability of a product to use no more than the specified amount of resources to perform its function under specified conditions

label: Responsiveness
definition: Degree to which an AI service responds and provides outcomes in a prompt and timely way

label: Reusability
definition: Capability of a product to be used as assets in more than one system, or in building other assets

label: Risk Identification
definition: Capability of a product to identify a course of events or operations that can expose life, property or environment to unacceptable risk

label: Risk Mitigation
definition: Extent to which a product  or system  mitigates the potential risk to economic status, human life, health, society, financial values, enterprise activities, or the environment

label: Robustness
definition: Degree to which an AI system can maintain its level of functional correctness under any circumstances

label: Safe Integration
definition: Capability of a product to maintain safety during and after integration with one or more components

label: Safety
definition: Capability of a product under defined conditions to avoid a state in which human life, health, property, or the environment is endangered

label: Scalability
definition: Capability of a product to handle growing or shrinking workloads or to adapt its capacity to handle variability

label: Security
definition: Capability of a product to protect information and data so that persons or other products have the degree of data access appropriate to their types and levels of authorization, and to defend against attack patterns by malicious actors

label: Self-descriptiveness
definition: Capability of a product to present appropriate information, where needed by the user, to make its capabilities and use immediately obvious to the user without excessive interactions with a product or other resources

label: ServiceAccessibility
definition: Degree to which an AI service can be used by people with the widest range of characteristics and capabilities to achieve a specified goal in a specified context of use

label: Service Adaptability
definition:
Degree to which a service can be adapted based on factors such as functions, responsibility, skill of
employees, communication style with users or instruments available

label: Service Analysability
definition: Degree of effectiveness and efficiency with which an AI service can be analysed for deficiencies, gaps and failures

label: Service Appropriateness Recognizability
definition: Degree to which users  can recognize whether an AI service is appropriate for their needs

label: Service Availability
definition: Degree to which an AI service is available to users when needed

label: Service Confidentiality
definition: Degree to which an AI service ensures that data are accessible only to those authorized to have access

label: Service Integrity
definition: Degree to which an AI service prevents unauthorized access to or modification of data whether accidently or intentionally

label: Service Interface Appearance
definition: Degree to which the interface of the service has an appearance or other physical properties that are pleasing and satisfying for the user

label: Service Learnability
definition: Degree to which an AI service can be learned by users to achieve a specified level of effectiveness, efficiency, freedom from risk and satisfaction within a specified amount of time and context of use

label: Service Maintainability
definition: Degree of effectiveness and efficiency with which the AI service can be modified by the service provider

label: Service Modifiability
definition: Degree to which an AI service can be effectively and efficiently modified without introducing defects or degrading existing AI service quality

label: Service Operability
definition: Degree to which an AI service has attributes that make it easy to operate and control

label: Service Recoverability
definition: Degree to which, in the event of an interruption or a failure or disaster, the original AI service and its functions and data can be re-established and made accessible

label: Service Reliability
definition: Degree to which an AI service provides consistent and stable AI service outcomes

label: Service Security
definition: Degree to which an AI service protects both user’s assets and access to their information so that users have the degree of information access appropriate to their levels of authorization

label: Service Testability
definition: Degree of effectiveness and efficiency with which test criteria can be established for an AI service and tests can be performed to determine whether those criteria have been met

label: Service Usability
definition: Degree to which an AI service can be used by specified users to achieve specified goals with effectiveness, efficiency and satisfaction in a specified context of use

label: Service User Error Protection
definition: Degree to which an AI service protects users against making errors

label: Societal And Ethical Risk Mitigation
definition: Degree to which a product or system mitigates the potential societal or ethical risks

label: Suitability
definition: Extent to which behaviours or outcomes, or both, of a product meet specified quality requirements when used

label: Tangibility
definition: Degree to which the tangible aspects of the AI service effectively communicate and support the service

label: Testability
definition: Capability of a product to enable an objective and feasible test to be designed and performed to determine whether a requirement is met

label: Time Behaviour
definition: Capability of a product to perform its specified function under specified conditions so that the response time and throughput rates meet the requirements

label: Timeliness
definition: Degree to which an AI service delivers outcomes within time limits

label: Traceability
definition: Degree to which the AI service outcomes can be traced to or from the user needs

label: Transparency
definition: Degree to which appropriate information about the AI system is communicated to relevant stakeholders

label: Trustworthiness
definition: Extent to which users or stakeholders  have confidence that their expectations are met in a verifiable way

label: Usability
definition: Extent to which a system, product or service can be used by specified users  to achieve specified goals with effectiveness, efficiency, and satisfaction in a specified context of use

label: User Assistance
definition: Capability of a product to be used by people with the widest range of characteristics and capabilities to achieve specified goals in a specified context of use

label: User Controllability
definition: Degree to which a user can appropriately intervene in an AI system’s functioning in a timely manner

label: User Engagement
definition: Capability of a product to present functions and information in an inviting and motivating manner encouraging continued interaction

label: User Error Protection
definition: Capability of a product to prevent operation errors

label: Visibility
definition: Degree to which users have insight into the capabilities of the AI service, how they will be delivered, and progress toward their completion during delivery
